title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Tier with Towel Bar, Wall Mount Solid Brass Gallery Rail Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Tier with Towel Bar
description:
Add organized storage with a 16-Inch wall-mount glass shelf featuring a double-tier design and an integrated towel bar. Part of the waverly place collection for coordinated, transitional bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Two tempered glass shelves help keep daily essentials within reach
- Solid brass gallery rail helps keep items secure on the shelf
- Integrated towel bar adds a convenient place for towels
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean wall-mounted look
- Designed to pair with matching waverly place pieces across transitional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Shelf length: 16 in
- Overall size: 16 in L x 12 in H x 5 in projection
- Glass thickness: 3/8 in (0.38 in) tempered glass
- Material: brass hardware
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: no
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: multiple designer finish options available

_previous.title: 16 Inch Gallery Double Glass Shelf with Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
